title: Lamar Jackson's peers don't think he's a top 50 player in the NFL

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Lamar Jackson's peers don't think he's a top 50 player in the NFL
sources.description: Lamar Jackson's peers voted him as the No. 2 player in the NFL ahead of the 2025 season. This year, he doesn't even crack the top 50.
